explain: Structure-aware chunks keep complete rule units instead of arbitrary fragments. The synthetic section delimiter stands in for a real document parser.
steps: Split on known section boundaries. || Preserve the exception in the same passage as the rule it qualifies.
name: chunk-boundaries

explain: This window counts words, repeats overlap, and rejects an overlap that prevents forward progress. It makes units and duplication explicit.
steps: Validate that size is positive and overlap is smaller than size. || Advance by size minus overlap rather than by the whole window.
name: sliding-windows

explain: Source bytes and processing profile jointly determine representation identity. Changing chunk size or embedding profile requires compatibility handling even when the source is unchanged.
steps: Serialize both source identity and transformation settings. || Compare fingerprints after changing only the chunk size.
name: processing-fingerprint

explain: Compare chunk configurations on the same labeled queries and include context cost. A recall gain alone does not decide which configuration fits the product.
steps: Keep the dataset identity fixed. || Compare evidence coverage together with rendered context tokens.
name: chunk-experiment

explain: A deterministic chunk identity can include source revision, processing profile, and position. This demonstrates one identity policy, not a claim that all backends use it.
steps: Build the identity from explicit stable components. || Change the processing profile and observe a different chunk identity.
name: stable-chunk-id

explain: Search a small child passage but recover the bounded parent context needed to interpret it. Parent retrieval must retain the same access and revision scope.
steps: Resolve the child's parent identity. || Fetch the matching parent text rather than concatenating arbitrary neighboring results.
name: parent-child
journey-862
explain: A source-linked reasoning fixture. JSON parsing checks representation only; reproduce the actual mechanism with the chapter reference.
steps: Inspect the declared input and required invariant. || Trace the chapter mechanism and reproduce the stated case. || Change the stated assumption and defend the result.
expect: Reasoning input only; no program result is claimed. Reproduce the scenario using the chapter’s runnable reference.
limit: A JSON case is parsed for representation integrity only, not executed as a proof of its semantic claim.
